name: example
description: Placeholder MCP server config — delete or rename once you wire a real server. Shows the shape: stdio transport, a command to launch the server, env vars scoping its access, and a tool surface the agent will see.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files in the configured data root. Read-only.

tools.name: read_summary
tools.description: Return a structured summary of a named data file (schema + descriptive stats). For sample-level access use slice_window.

tools.name: slice_window
tools.description: Return raw samples for a named file + range. Use sparingly — large windows blow up context.

_notes: This spec is a placeholder. The server implementation does not exist. Replace with a real server before relying on it. The pattern (list / summary / slice) generalises across telemetry, drawings, schematics, lab measurements — start there and adapt.
